review.posthog_relevance: Desktop agent session UI accessibility and interaction behavior
review.reason: The observed changes are localized to the Desktop agent session UI, specifically the AgentMessage component. P1.F1.H1 adds a mock and a test for file reference rendering, while P1.F2.H2 adds keyboard support and preserves selection behavior. These represent a substantive, bounded improvement in accessibility and interaction reliability for desktop users, warranting a score of 2. No
review.uncertainty: The tier assignment relies on the assumption that these specific UI changes are not part of a larger, systemic architectural shift not visible in this chunk. The score is assigned based on the localized nature of the changes rather than broader systemic impact.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single PR group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment performed.

observations.behavior: Adds a mock for the useCwd hook, returning undefined, and adds a test asserting that inline file references are rendered as selectable text rather than buttons.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent session UI; the mock supports the AgentMessage component, while the test checks accessibility and selection behavior of file references.

observations.behavior: Adds a keyboard event handler and replaces a button with a span, retaining accessibility and selection behavior.
observations.posthog_connection: Desktop agent session UI; the change preserves the ability to select and copy chat text while adding keyboard support, though the implementation uses a non-button element with role='button'.
